add_files: Add another quotes/*.json file, and an organisations/*.json file when the customer is new. Use schema aeon.quote-showcase.v1 and a new key. The loader reads every file in those directories and does not hard-code quote names.

features.sections-numbering: acme-platform uses decimal, upper-roman and lower-alpha. acme-fitout uses upper-alpha, lower-roman and none.
features.lists: acme-platform uses disc, circle and a decimal outline with depth, list start, list continue and section binding. acme-fitout uses square, dash and a glyph.
features.inline-marks: acme-platform marks Inbetriebnahme bold and vor Ort italic. That selects document writer 2.
features.section-layout: acme-platform keeps a section together and sets spacing. acme-fitout starts a section on a new page.
features.positions: acme-platform mixes units and decimal quantities. acme-fitout carries long position texts and a revised price in version 2.
features.optional-scope: Optional and alternative scope is prose on acme-platform and acme-fitout. The document model has no optional or alternative position, so that scope is not priced and is not summed.
features.discount-note: Every quote stores a discount note. The tenant default profile hides the discount line. ACME English shows the note as a line. No percent is calculated.
features.vat: German quotes store a VAT note for a profile that renders the note. ACME English uses a VAT line.
features.payment-terms: German quotes include a Zahlungsbedingungen section, because the default profile places payment terms in sections. ACME English renders the payment-terms field after the totals.
features.acceptance: Every quote has accept text. The default profile uses two signature columns. ACME English uses one. acme-acceptance is accepted by the bound contact.
features.versions: acme-fitout is issued, branched and issued again as version 2.
features.public-link: acme-platform is issued with a public link when the host link key is present.
features.states: acme-retainer stays a draft. acme-platform and acme-fitout are issued and open. acme-acceptance is accepted.
features.pagination: acme-fitout is long and starts one section on a new page.
features.locales: The German quotes use the tenant default profile, which is de-AT after the INSPR profile is applied with --default. acme-retainer uses the bundle profile ACME English, locale en, layout standard.
features.variables: The only variables are the profile footer tokens {page} and {total}. Quote prose is not mail-merged.
